lastCompletedStory.title: Add the deterministic tmpdir gate with falsifiability probe and empty allowlist mechanism

nextStoryContext: US-008 added scripts/check-test-tmpdir.ts (exported pure scanForTmpdirRoots(files, allowlist?) + filterScannablePaths + a CLI main molded on scripts/check-test-sleeps.ts) and test/check-test-tmpdir.test.ts (17 tests). The gate flags a tmpdir() call (bare, os.tmpdir() namespaced, or a same-file `import { tmpdir as X } from 'node:os'` alias) reaching either a join(...) call or a slash-bearing template-literal interpolation; it does NOT flag a bare tmpdir() comparand (GOTCHA 8). Runs clean over the real tree today (bun scripts/check-test-tmpdir.ts -> 'check:test-tmpdir: ok'), confirming US-007's derived-zero migration holds. Falsifiability probe verified live: planting a single rooting site in a throwaway $(mktemp -d)/test/leak-probe.test.ts turns the gate red and names the file; cleanup uses rm -f + rmdir only (no rm -rf), entirely outside the working tree. CLI accepts an optional scanRoot argv (default: repo test/, glob pattern is always 'test/**/*.{ts,tsx}' relative to the given/default root) and a --print-allowlist flag. Allowlist mechanism is real and working (a {path,reason} array): an entry naming a path outside the scanned file set is itself surfaced as a stale-allowlist-entry finding (proven with SYNTHETIC entries in the test file, not the real one), so a dangling entry fails the gate the same way a real violation would. The real exported ALLOWLIST stays empty by design -- its only legitimate future consumers are the PRODUCT leak-regression tests of the sister issue, which is presumably where this gate should also get wired into scripts/check-all.ts's mandatory spine (deliberately NOT done in this story: no acceptance criterion required it, and the story's own file-scope note named only the two new files -- Surgical Changes). GOTCHA 3 confirmed exactly as predicted: added a single-quoted '.cam-test-tmp' literal to EXCLUDED_DIRS (defensive, keeps a leftover scratch dir from ever being scanned), which raised scripts/check-gitignore-parity.sh's derived PROBES from 42 to 43 (measured); still far above the test/check-gitignore-parity-script.test.ts degeneracy floor of 10, so no floor edit was needed. Self-referential gate gotcha (see patterns.md for the full write-up): the gate's own test file lives under test/ and gets scanned by the gate's AC1 real-tree run, so every one of the 6 flaggable-form fixtures (not just the classic mkdtempSync one) had to be assembled via two generic, parameterized helpers (bareCall(name), pathJoin(inner,rest)) whose own bodies never mention 'tmpdir' literally -- this generalizes past the single-spelling splitting trick US-003's codemod-test fixtures used. scanForTmpdirRoots was refactored into findStaleAllowlistEntries + scanFileForRoots + a filter/flatMap composition to stay under biome's cognitive-complexity ceiling (was 18, ceiling 15). Full bun test: 6064 pass / 0 fail (6047 + this story's 17 new tests). bun run check:all green, no file-size/coverage _ref raise needed. All non-operator PRD stories (US-001..US-008) should now be complete; the next agent (if any) should check prd.json for remaining stories before assuming more migration work is needed.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Glob.scanSync's cwd option scans **-recursively under that directory and returns paths relative to cwd (unless absolute:true) -- confirmed matches this story's CLI design (optional scanRoot argv drives cwd, glob pattern stays 'test/**/*.{ts,tsx}'), also empirically verified via the AC2 falsifiability probe.
